entries.title: Psalms 110:1
segments: <<A Psalm of David.>> Jehovah saith unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, Until I make thine enemies thy footstool.

entries.title: Psalms 110:2
segments: Jehovah will  send forth the  rod of thy strength out of Zion: Rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.

entries.title: Psalms 110:3
segments: Thy people  offer themselves willingly  In the day of thy  power,  in holy array: Out of the womb of the morning  Thou hast the dew of thy youth.

entries.title: Psalms 110:4
segments: Jehovah hath sworn, and will not repent: Thou art a priest for ever After the  order of Melchizedek.

entries.title: Psalms 110:5
segments: The Lord at thy right hand  Will strike through kings in the day of his wrath.

entries.title: Psalms 110:6
segments: He will judge among the nations,  He  will fill [the places] with dead bodies; He  will strike through the head  in many countries.

entries.title: Psalms 110:7
segments: He will drink of the brook in the way: Therefore will he lift up the head.
